summary: Verified Room Occupancy Heatmap feature addition to S-ROOM (Room Orders Insights) page. All features working correctly: heatmap renders with data-testid='chart-occupancy-heatmap', shows rooms on Y-axis (10 rooms: 101, 103, 104, 105, 106, 107, 108, 109, 204, 206), Mon-Sun on X-axis, color-coded cells (20 green, 50 gray out of 70 total), number overlays for check-in counts, Low-High legend, and CSS-only tooltips showing room/day/check-ins/revenue on hover. All existing features (KPIs, charts, tabs, table) and Gate ⑤ fixes remain intact.
critical_code_review_comments: Heatmap implementation is clean - uses useMemo for data aggregation (lines 365-398)
Zero additional API calls - heatmap data computed from existing filtered rows
CSS-only tooltips using group-hover pattern work correctly
Color intensity calculation is correct: rgba(22, 163, 74, intensity) for green cells
Room sorting is natural (numeric sort for room numbers)
